title: Comparisons with 比
explanation: 比  is the standard way to compare two things: A 比 B + Adj means "A is more Adj than B." No 很  is needed before the adjective.

examples.pinyin: zhōng wén bǐ yīng wén nán
zhè běn shū bǐ nà běn guì
examples.english: This book is more expensive than that one.

examples.pinyin: xià tiān bǐ dōng tiān rè

notes: Do not use 很 with 比 comparisons (说：我比他高, not 我比他很高). For "much more" add 多 了: 我比他高多了. For "a little more" add 一点 / 些: 我比他高一点.
